description: This file is the entry point for a React-based front-end application. It imports React, ReactDOM, styles, and the main App component, then renders the App inside the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React component tree into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree starting with <App /> inside the specified root.
